description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Arbor Adherent.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
